question: Should OpenClaw accept a generic durable plugin allow-always API and persistent trust store in this PR, including a Skill Workshop opt-in?
rationale: The PR changes a plugin-facing API and can suppress future approval prompts, so maintainers need to choose the durable trust boundary and whether Skill Workshop should participate before merge.

options.title: Fix and accept generic durable approvals
options.body: Require a stable owner, non-sensitive scope, upgrade-safe docs/tests, and second-call proof before accepting the new API and Skill Workshop opt-in.

options.title: Split Skill Workshop out
options.body: Land only the generic persistence mechanism after API/security review and keep Skill Workshop on allow-once/deny until its owner/audit model is ready.

options.title: Reject durable plugin approvals for now
options.body: Close or pause the PR if maintainers do not want plugin approvals to gain core-owned durable allow-always persistence yet.

recommendation.title: Fix and accept generic durable approvals
recommendation.body: Require a stable owner, non-sensitive scope, upgrade-safe docs/tests, and second-call proof before accepting the new API and Skill Workshop opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Skill Workshop approval work and approval-surface history make this the best available routing owner for the security/product choice.
